title: Ok(ish)
text: Ok(ish). This is ok and made of solid wood. Easy to put together.  Would be awesome if the angle was another 1-2 degrees.  As it currently is designed any vibration causes the cups to spill out. Not all but enough to be annoying. I returned it but if you put it somewhere it won’t get jiggled and don’t mind occasionally picking a few cups up then it’s a good deal.
